answer: Identity bonds that rust stop sybil floods. Each agent locks a ferrous bond of 200 POA to join. It decays 5% each epoch unless honest work refreshes it. A falcon-swift audit samples agents each epoch; a caught fake forfeits its remaining bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA, and keeping them alive demands a river of work no attacker can sustain. An honest agent pays once, works once, and keeps its bond and rewards undiluted.
